expected_negative_caption:
Expected-negative interpretation: the video terminal label “FAILED: SAFE_ABORT_TIPPED_OR_SPILLED” means the pour/heat task failed as intended.
The safety-negative response passed: stable native diagnosis, then 1.000 s / 60 observations with fixed open-hold commands and heater OFF.
Terminal cup visibility is partly occluded by the gripper; video alone is insufficient. Raw cup pose and particle counts support the branch.
Counts use the original smoothed display-point observer. Gross-wall-leak flag = 3; no raw zero-penetration or positive-task success claim.
terminal_label_explanation: FAILED SAFE_ABORT denotes the intentionally failed positive pour/heat task. It does not mean this expected safety-negative response failed.
visual_limitation: Gripper partly occludes fallen transparent cup in terminal video. Video alone cannot verify its full pose; raw native cup pose and particle partitions support the branch.
temporal_scope: Raw60Hz observations plotted without resampling or inferred substep states. Pulse markers use recorded5 native callbacks; inset shows original samples.
